projects.name: Implemented Reporting and Dashboard capabilities in ServiceNow to standardize
details: KPI tracking, SLA monitoring, and request fulfilment visibility across regional teams. Enabled
operational teams and management to monitor ticket trends, aging, and workload distribution
through interactive dashboards.
• Designed interactive dashboards and custom ITSM reports for Incident, Service Requests, and
Request Fulfilment performance.
• Built trend and SLA compliance reports using Report Designer and dashboard widgets.
• Created report sources and database views for cross-table reporting across Incident, Task, SLA,
and User tables using dot-walking.
• Automated scheduled KPI report sharing and implemented role-based access to dashboards.
• Analysed ticket data to identify bottlenecks and improvement areas in request workflows.
• Performed data validation and root cause analysis to ensure reporting accuracy.
• Provided user training and created knowledge articles for effective dashboard and report usage.
• Supported UAT and post-go-live by resolving reporting enhancements and defects.
